notes: DESIGN PROPOSAL. Objectives are soft guidance goals, NOT hard gates. They structure the player's first 20 days and feed HUD prompts; failing a non-win objective never ends the game.

VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT: day/AP economy = FSoulCampaignEconomy (Day starts 1, MaxActionPoints=3). AdvanceDay grows pools weekly ((Day-1)%7==0). All day numbers below respect that 7-day cadence.

VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT: founder slice regions = human_capital, crossroads, old_quarry, river_ford, forest_edge, ancient_shrine, orc_watch, north_pass, orc_camp (Data/soul_world_overmap_v1_20260922.json founder_slice).

LOCAL RUNTIME/ASSET CHECK REQUIRED: whether all six-faction seat settlements are walkable/visitable is NOT a Lane 1 claim (see Lane 6). Objective text that assumes a walkable Dwarf Hold / Viking Harbour is gated on that lane.
objective_completion is evaluated in the SAME two hooks as victory (ApplyBattleResult, AdvanceDay) by a pure FSoulCampaignObjectiveRules::EvaluateGoal reading serialized state.

objective_kinds.comment: Campaign objective kinds are DISTINCT from the tactical ESoulObjectiveKind in SoulObjectives.h (EliminateEnemy/HoldHexes/etc). Proposed new enum ESoulCampaignGoalKind in SoulCore/Public/SoulCampaignObjectives.h.

early_days_1_7.intent: Onboarding. Teach move/encounter/recruit/develop/visit. One clear carrot per core system. Deterministic, no spam.

goals.label: First Blood
goals.teaches: RBCombat battle loop + ApplyBattleResult region capture
goals.verified_hook: VERIFIED: bBattleWon set in ApplyBattleResult; +600 gold first-time reward per region already exists.

goals.label: Raise a Company
goals.teaches: finite recruitment pools (FSoulCampaignRules::Recruit) at the capital
goals.constraint: VERIFIED: recruit only when PlayerRegion==human_capital and owned (Recruit() guard).

goals.label: Touch the Arcane
goals.teaches: strategic sites (FSoulHeartlandSite / InteractHeartlandSite) + magic affinity hook
goals.note: Satisfied by owning ancient_shrine OR a recorded HeartlandSiteDays interaction.

early_days_1_7.onboarding_victory_hint: Surface the enabled victory approaches on the HUD by day 3 with 0 progress rings, so the player learns the win menu early.

midgame_days_8_20.intent: Open the strategic decision space: expansion vs development, diplomacy vs war, which victory approach to commit to.

goals.label: Breakout
goals.six_faction_mapping: expand from 2 starting possessions toward safe_expansion_targets + one rival frontier region

goals.label: Hero Ascendant
goals.verified_hook: VERIFIED: Hero.Level/KnownSpells via FSoulHeroRules; ApplyBattleResult awards +360 XP/win.

goals.label: Crack a Wall
goals.verified_hook: VERIFIED: FSoulSiegeState.bVictory; Human Capital Siege V0 is the reference. Do NOT change Siege V0 (Lane 7 owns Siege V1).
goals.constraint: LOCAL RUNTIME/ASSET CHECK REQUIRED for any siege target beyond human_capital.

endgame_days_21_plus.intent: Escalate pressure so games converge. Commit to one victory approach; the world pushes back.

escalation_model.trigger_alt: any faction (player or rival) crosses 400 permille region share

escalation_effects.effect: Occupied non-homeland regions (owner != homeland_affinity) accrue an unrest flag that reduces their income contribution. Discourages infinite shallow conquest; rewards consolidation or diplomacy.
Surviving rival playable factions receive a one-time recruitment/readiness bonus the first day the leader crosses 400 permille, so a runaway leader faces a stiffer final push.
escalation_effects.dependency: Lane 2 recruitment; inert until strategic AI drives armies.

escalation_effects.effect: Strategic/arcane sites spawn seeded defender/raider events once escalation is active, making site-control and magical-supremacy approaches contested rather than passive holds.

goals.label: Claim Your Destiny
goals.note: The capstone objective: satisfy any enabled victory condition from campaign_victory_schema.json.

goals.label: Hold the Line
goals.note: Soft stalemate guard: if no faction wins by day 60, surface a 'score victory' summary (region+site+hero+treasury weighted). DESIGN PROPOSAL; scoring weights pending Lane 9.
